title: Mobs
summary: Every custom SkyRPG mob: where it spawns, how tough it is, its tricks and what it drops.

s.x: SkyRPG adds its own monsters on top of vanilla's. Each one is a new kind of mob built on a vanilla body, with its own look, attacks and drops. They get levels, nameplates and damage numbers like any other hostile mob, they can be Elites, and several of them count for
. This page is the field guide. For the full item list of any drop, see the
Health in this page is the base health on the SkyRPG scale (5 health is 1 vanilla point), before the level bonus of +8% per level above 1. See

s.x: These have no biome spawns in the overworld. The world's layer and biome systems spawn them in their own places, and each has a spawn egg in the creative Spawn Eggs tab.
